correctness.rationale: For one-dimensional full even N>=4, alpha=1, kernel K=1+gamma sum_{k≠0} e^{2πik(s-t)}/k² and density mu=(π/2)|sin2πt|, nonzero circulant DFT modes of optimal weights equal integrals of periodic triangular nodal hats. Only the zero mode differs, yielding w_j=b_j-gamma*d_N/[N(1+gamma*a_N)]. Direct Fourier series of mu and cotangent sum give d_N=1-(π/N)cot(π/N)>a_N and b_min=B_N=1/2-N sin(2π/N)/(4π), only at j=0,N/2 by circular-unimodal convolution. Thus solving w_min=0 yields exact gamma_N, with two zero weights at equality and negative above. Transformed node coincidences allow a nonnegative polynomial supported only at x=0 to witness negative quadrature. Taylor expansion gives gamma_N=N+π²/3+O(N^-1), while constant Q(1) crosses at gamma=(d-a)^-1~45 N^4/π^4. Independent quadrature and direct Bernoulli-kernel matrix solves for N=4,6,...,16 matched hat+offset to 8.3e-13. Finite checks corroborate the Fourier argument, do not establish all N.
